thread.title: Netflix Renewal Rate 'Astronomical,' Research Firm Says | Investor's Business Daily

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Netflix Renewal Rate 'Astronomical,' Research Firm Says | Investor's Business Daily
text:
A survey of U.S. streaming video subscribers finds that Netflix ( NFLX ) has by far the most loyal customers.
X Netflix has the highest renewal rate, at 93%, Lab42 Research said in a news release Monday. That compares with 75% for Amazon ( AMZN ) Prime Video and 64% for Hulu, which were the next highest.
"Many factors contribute to Netflix's astronomical renewal rate," said Jonathan Pirc, founder and managing partner of Lab42. "These include an increasing number of cord-cutters, its hyper-customized content and suggestions, which helps to increase engagement and reduce abandonment, and a significant investment in original content."
The Chicago-based market research firm surveyed 500 U.S. consumers that were using a streaming service in late October.

Average Streaming Video Customer Uses 2.5 Services Among all streaming video users, 89% subscribe to Netflix, Lab42 said. Most Netflix users (75%) also subscribe to other streaming services. Streaming video consumers use an average of 2.5 streaming video services, the survey showed.
"On average, consumers use between two and three streaming services, and one of them is almost always Netflix," Pirc said. "Even with multiple streaming services available, Netflix has clearly staked out the dominant position."
Netflix's stock rose 1.7% to close at 269.70 on the stock market today .
The streaming video space is going to get more crowded next year as Walt Disney ( DIS ), AT&T 's ( T ) WarnerMedia and Apple ( AAPL ) join the fray.
